{"claim_id": "c2", "code": "import torch, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_163")
import kernel
dev = "cuda"
def exact_dft(x):
    N = x.shape[1]
    k = torch.arange(N//2+1, device=x.device, dtype=torch.complex128)
    j = torch.arange(N, device=x.device, dtype=torch.complex128)
    M = torch.exp(-2j * torch.pi * torch.outer(k, j).real * 0)  # placeholder
    return None
# simpler correct reference: torch.fft.rfft on float64 (library complex128)
res = {"per_N": {}}
overall_ok = True
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    B = 4
    rows = []
    x = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    for b in range(B):
        x[b, b*7 % N] = 1.0
    rows.append(("impulse", x))
    xs = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    for b in range(B):
        j = torch.arange(N, device=dev, dtype=torch.float64)
        freq = (b*3+1)
        xs[b] = torch.cos(2*torch.pi*freq*j/N + b).to(torch.float16)
    rows.append(("sinusoid", xs))
    xn = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    xn[0] = 1.0; xn[1] = -1.0
    xn[2,:] = (torch.arange(N,device=dev,dtype=torch.float16)%2*2-1).to(torch.float16)
    rows.append(("dc_nyquist_alt", xn))
    rows.append(("random", torch.randn(B, N, device=dev, dtype=torch.float16)))
    bad = 0; worst = 0.0; worst_info = None
    for name, xr in rows:
        out = kernel.run(xr)
        ref = torch.fft.rfft(xr.to(torch.float64), dim=1, norm="backward")
        ex = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1)
        err = (out.double() - ex).abs()
        tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6*ex.abs()
        viol = (err > tol)
        if viol.any():
            idx = int((err - tol).argmax())
            bad += int(viol.sum())
            worst_info = {"test": name, "flat_idx": idx, "err": float(err.flatten()[idx]), "tol": float(tol.flatten()[idx])}
        worst = max(worst, (err/tol).max().item())
    res["per_N"][N] = {"worst_err_over_tol": worst, "violations": bad, "worst_case": worst_info}
    overall_ok = overall_ok and bad == 0
res["all_pass"] = overall_ok
print(res)", "expected_signal": "All N in {64,128,256} and impulse/adversarial spectra match exact DFT within tolerance (expect failure given c1 evidence)"}

{"claim_id": "c3", "code": "import torch, sys, math
sys.path.insert(0, "/root/cases/case_163")
import kernel
from kernel import _COSINE
dev = "cuda"
tab_maxdiff = max(abs(v - math.cos(2*math.pi*i/256)) for i, v in enumerate(_COSINE))
res = {"table_maxdiff": tab_maxdiff, "cases": {}}
total_bad = 0; worst = 0.0
for N in (64, 128, 256):
    B = 6
    big = torch.finfo(torch.float16).max
    x = torch.zeros(B, N, dtype=torch.float16, device=dev)
    x[0,:] = big
    x[1,:] = -big
    x[2,:] = torch.where(torch.arange(N,device=dev)%2==0, torch.tensor(big,device=dev), torch.tensor(-big,device=dev)).to(torch.float16)
    x[3,:] = torch.linspace(big, 1.0, N, device=dev).to(torch.float16)
    x[4] = (torch.randn(N, device=dev) * 20000).to(torch.float16)
    x[5,:] = 5.96e-8
    out = kernel.run(x)
    ref = torch.fft.rfft(x.to(torch.float64), dim=1, norm="backward")
    ex = torch.stack((ref.real, ref.imag), dim=-1)
    err = (out.double() - ex).abs()
    tol = 1e-4 + 1e-6*ex.abs()
    viol = int((err > tol).sum())
    ratio = (err/tol).max().item()
    fin = bool(torch.isfinite(out).all())
    res["cases"][N] = {"violations": viol, "worst_err_over_tol": ratio, "finite": fin, "max_exact_mag": float(ex.abs().max())}
    total_bad += viol
    worst = max(worst, ratio)
res["all_pass"] = total_bad == 0
res["worst_ratio"] = worst
print(res)", "expected_signal": "Extreme FP16 rows stay within 1e-4+1e-6*|exact| of exact DFT and are finite; table literals are true doubles"}
